tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on every light and pastel surface (brand guide secondary #020A13; 8:1 or better on all bg-* colours). Headings, body, table text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, footers, captions, source lines (brand guide secondary #22364C; 6:1 or better on bg-sky and lighter).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Brand guide secondary #7D8E9F. Rules, icons, disabled states and chart neutrals. Not for text: 3.3:1 on surface-card.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Dark cards, the highlighted MailerCloud node in diagrams, emphasis pills, bar fills and report table headers (brand guide secondary #091929). Text on it is surface-card or white.

tokens.name: navy-line
tokens.usage: Divider rules inside navy cards.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour #046DFF (brand guide). The logo cloud, the header rule, links, the one highlighted chart bar and the new-route arrows. Contrast is 4.4:1 on white and surface-card (just under AA for small text), 3.5:1 on bg-lime and 2.1:1 on bg-sky: use it for large text, graphics and the logo, underline any link, and use navy on bg-sky.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, diagram nodes and pinned panels on top of pastel grounds. Ink text.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Summary boxes at the top of a report page. Ink text.

tokens.name: surface-zebra
tokens.usage: Alternate table rows and KPI tiles on white report pages. Ink text.

tokens.name: bg-sky
tokens.usage: Cover, closing and data-flow slide grounds. The brand's lead background. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

tokens.name: bg-lime
tokens.usage: Slide ground for context and decision slides; also pill fill on white cards. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

tokens.name: bg-mint
tokens.usage: Slide ground for comparison and capability slides. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

tokens.name: bg-green
tokens.usage: Slide ground for capacity and numbers slides; the 'no change' pill. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

tokens.name: bg-pink
tokens.usage: Slide ground for options and proof slides. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

tokens.name: bg-cream
tokens.usage: Slide ground for diagrams and charts that need a quiet field. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

tokens.name: bg-yellow
tokens.usage: Rare high-energy ground from the company overview (Drag and drop builder page). Use for at most one slide in a deck. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

tokens.name: bg-paper
tokens.usage: Near-white ground for text-heavy slides (security, policy) and the page ground for reports.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Table rules, footer rules and card outlines on white pages.

tokens.name: attention-bg
tokens.usage: Rows and callouts that need a closer look. Always paired with a text label such as 'Worth a closer look'.

tokens.name: attention-line
tokens.usage: Rule beside an attention callout.

tokens.name: attention-ink
tokens.usage: Text on attention-bg (6:1).

tokens.name: positive-bg
tokens.usage: Confirmation pills and the 'unchanged' row in a table.

tokens.name: positive-ink
tokens.usage: Text on positive-bg.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Brand guide behaviour colour for success. Status dots, confirmation icons, positive deltas. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Brand guide behaviour colour for error. Failures and blocking states. Text on it is ink (4.8:1); white is only 4.2:1, so use white on it for large text only.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Brand guide behaviour colour for warning. Attention markers and icons. Text on it is ink. attention-bg is its tint.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Brand guide behaviour colour for information. Info banners and highlights. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: chart-grey
tokens.usage: The comparison or previous-period bar in a chart (alias of slate).

tokens.name: chart-light
tokens.usage: The residual 'all other' segment in a stacked bar.

tokens.name: code-key
tokens.usage: JSON keys on navy code cards.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: JSON string values on navy code cards.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Punctuation and plain text on navy code cards.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Semantic. Default text colour. Alias of ink.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Semantic. Captions, footers, source lines. Alias of ink-muted.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Semantic. Text on navy and other inverse surfaces.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Semantic. Links. Always underlined because brand-blue is 4.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Semantic. Page ground for reports and text-heavy slides.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Semantic. Cards and diagram nodes above a page or pastel ground.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Semantic. Dark cards, the MailerCloud node and code cards.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Semantic. Table rules and footer hairlines.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Semantic. Diagram node outlines and the connector lines of existing paths.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Semantic. The main call-to-action colour on white grounds.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Semantic. Keyboard focus outline on interactive artefacts, 3px, offset 2px.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Semantic. Success indicators. Pair with the word.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Semantic. Warning indicators. Pair with the word.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Semantic. Error indicators. Pair with the word.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Semantic. Information indicators. Pair with the word.

tokens.name: card-bg
tokens.usage: Component. Fill of the Card.

tokens.name: card-inverse-bg
tokens.usage: Component. Fill of the dark Card and CodeCard.

tokens.name: table-header-bg
tokens.usage: Component. Header row of the DataTable.

tokens.name: table-row-alt-bg
tokens.usage: Component. Alternate DataTable row on white pages.

tokens.name: node-line
tokens.usage: Component. Outline of a DiagramNode.

tokens.name: node-inverse-bg
tokens.usage: Component. Fill of the MailerCloud DiagramNode.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Data visualisation, series 1 and the default bar.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Data visualisation, series 2 and the highlighted bar.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Data visualisation, series 3 and comparison values.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Data visualisation, series 4. Label directly; it is close to chart-5 in lightness.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Data visualisation, series 5. Label directly.

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: Cover and closing titles, one big number per slide.

styles.name: t-title
styles.usage: Slide title, one line where possible.

styles.name: t-lead
styles.usage: Subtitle and body text in sparse cards.

styles.name: t-body
styles.usage: Body text in dense cards and diagram nodes.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Pills, diagram captions, footers. Nothing on a slide is smaller than this.

styles.name: t-code
styles.usage: API examples on navy code cards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a pill and its neighbour; gap between stacked cards' small elements.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card between heading and body; gap between title and subtitle.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-card-tight
tokens.usage: Card padding when five cards sit across a slide (rollout plan).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between side-by-side cards; card padding on dense slides.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a slide title and its content; card padding on sparse slides.

tokens.name: space-margin
tokens.usage: Slide margin on all four sides (bottom 160px when a footer row is present).

tokens.name: space-logo-top
tokens.usage: Distance from the top edge of a slide to the logo. The logo is 45px tall, so it ends at 101px and leaves 51px before the eyebrow at 152px.

tokens.name: space-footer
tokens.usage: Distance from the bottom edge of a slide to the footer row (url left, page number right, 24px).

tokens.name: space-title-top
tokens.usage: Distance from the top edge of a content slide to the eyebrow line; the title follows 8px below.

tokens.name: space-content-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a content slide: content ends at y 880, leaving the footer band clear.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Chart bar tops.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, diagram nodes, code cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and tags (fully rounded).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Discs, icon circles and the decorative circles on covers.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: White cards on pastel grounds. A hard offset shadow with no blur.

tokens.name: shadow-card-dark
tokens.usage: Navy cards on pastel grounds.

tokens.name: shadow-small
tokens.usage: Diagram nodes and banners.
